params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details, eye-catching. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. Leave the upper 35% of the frame as clean empty background for a big headline and the bottom 15% clean for a CTA button. Concept: a missing piece in your protection. A big glossy 3D shield made of puzzle pieces floats in the center, one puzzle piece is missing and that gap glows red with a small red alert badge; the missing piece hovers beside it. A small smartphone with a notification bubble rests at the shield's base. Clean pastel blue-and-white background, cinematic rim light.
